meaning.en: Simple past tense and past participle of repatriate.
meaning.vi: Quá khứ đơn và quá khứ phân từ hồi hương.

meaning_vi: cho hồi hương, cho trở về nước

sentences.en: The majority of them were repatriated by the French.

sentences.en: He was taken to a MASH in Tangiers and was eventually repatriated on his 21st birthday (22nd April 1944 ).
sentences.vi: Anh ta được đưa đến một MASH ở Tangiers và cuối cùng được hồi hương vào sinh nhật thứ 21 của mình (22 tháng 4 năm 1944).

sentences.en: The family were then repatriated in May, 1917.
sentences.vi: Gia đình sau đó đã được hồi hương vào tháng 5 năm 1917.

sentences.en: By February 1910 the last of the coolies had been repatriated.

sentences.en: Alone, over 12,000 South African (white) soldiers were repatriated by the end of 1916 due to malaria.

sentences.en: In addition, any tax on gains within the bond is deferred until such time as the funds are repatriated onshore.

sentences.en: He was repatriated at the end of 1945, she recalled.
